# Figma Connector for Muse

A Muse agent skill that reads from your Figma: the authenticated user, file metadata (name, last modified, version, thumbnail), and posts comments on files — plain or anchored to a node. Commenting needs exact confirmation; reading needs none. No secrets in the repo — credentials stay in Muse's secure vault.
